title: यमुना नदी निगरानी पर आरटीआई उत्तर
subject: Seeking point-wise information regarding Yamuna river monitoring at Haryana for the year 2026.
questions: What is the water quality of river Yamuna in Haryana state, and how is it monitored? Please provide the data.
What are the details of the source of pollution and sewerage generation?
Please provide information regarding drain monitoring and details of tapped and untapped drains.
response_summary: The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) provided point-wise information regarding Yamuna river monitoring in Haryana for the year 2026. It stated that water quality is monitored by the Haryana State Pollution Control Board (HSPCB) under the National Water Quality Monitoring Programme, with data available on their website. Details on pollution sources and sewerage generation are accessible on the NMCG website, and information regarding drain monitoring and tapping status was enclosed as a 'latest communication' with annexures.

CP
This has reference to your RTI application dated 30.10.2026 bearing online registration No.
CPCBD/R/E/26/01269 which was received in this division on 07.11.2026, seeking point-wise
information regarding Yamuna river monitoring at Haryana for the year 2026.

In this regard, it is pointed out that CPIO under the RTI Act, 2005 is not supposed to give reply
to any query, question or create any information. However, as per the available information,
the point wise reply is provided below:

Reply to Point No. 1,2&3: Water quality of river Yamuna in Haryana state, which is being
monitored by the Haryana State Pollution Control Board (HSPCB) under the National Water
Quality Monitoring Programme (NWMP). The data in excel format may be accessed through
following HSPCB website link:

https://hspcb.org.in/page/water-quality-of-drains-rivers-in-haryana

the latest Monthly Progress Report (in PDF format) received from HSPCB in the NGT matter
OA No. 673 of 2018, are available on the NMCG website at the following link:

https://nmcg.nic.in/writereaddata/fileupload/ngtmpr/53_Haryana%20MPR%20August-
2026.pdf

Reply to Points No. 5 & 6: The latest communication sent to HSPCB regarding drain
monitoring is enclosed. Details of the tapped and untapped drains are provided in the letter's
annexure.

The Appellate Authority in this case is Member Secretary, CPCB, Parivesh Bhawan,
East Arjun Nagar, Delhi-110032.

विषयः हरियाणा राज्य में यमुना नदी में गिरने वाले नालों से उत्पन्न प्रदूषण के संबंध में।
महोदय,
केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) ने हरियाणा राज्य प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (HPSPCB) के साथ मिलकर प्री-
मानसून 2026 (15.04.2026 से 23.04.2026) में हरियाणा राज्य में यमुना नदी में गिरने वाले 04 नालों की संयुक्त निगरानी
की। स्थलीय निरीक्षण एवं निगरानी के दौरान प्राप्त जल गुणवत्ता संबंधी आंकड़ों और अवलोकनों के आधार पर निम्नलिखित
प्रमुख तथ्य प्रकाश में आए हैं:
1. धनौरा एस्केप (डिच ड्रेन), करनाल नाले में BOD (34 mg/l) और COD (183 mg/l) उच्च स्तर का पाया गया।
2. चारों नालों का कुल BOD लोड 9.649 TPD पाया गया।
3. अलीपुर नाले के किनारे ठोस कचरा फेंका हुआ पाया गया।
4. निगरानी किए गए सभी नाले बिना ट्रीटमेंट के (untapped) पाए गए।
5. सभी नालों के विश्लेषण के नतीजे और उनसे जुड़ी जानकारी साथ में दी गई है।
उपर्युक्त समस्याओं को हल करने के लिए तुरंत निम्नलिखित कदम उठाने का सुझाव दिया जाता है:
1. पहचाने गए नालों में ज़्यादा BOD लोड वाले डिस्चार्ज को रोकने के लिए तुरंत कदम उठाना और प्रदूषण फैलाने
वाले स्रोतों के ख़िलाफ़ उचित कार्रवाई करना।
2. सॉलिड वेस्ट मैनेजमेंट (SWM) नियम, 2026 के तहत नालों के किनारे गंदा सामान/कचरा/स्लज या कोई अन्य
ठोस कचरा फेंकने पर रोक लगाने के लिए सख़्त नियम लागू करना। साथ ही, संबंधित अधिकारियों को पहले से
फेंके गए ठोस कचरे को हटाने और उसे सुरक्षित रूप से डिस्पोज़ करने का निर्देश देना।
3. यमुना नदी में गिरने वाले गंदे पानी के सही ट्रीटमेंट को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए, नालों को पास के STPs से पूरी तरह
जोड़ने (टैपिंग) तक, अंतरिम सुधारात्मक उपाय अपनाने के लिए संबंधित अधिकारियों को निर्देश देना।
अतः, आपसे अनुरोध है कि उपरोक्त प्रकरण का परीक्षण कर आवश्यक सुधारात्मक एवं निवारक उपायों के प्रभावी
क्रियान्वयन हेतु संबंधित अधिकारियों को निर्देशित करने का कष्ट करें, ताकि यमुना नदी में प्रदूषण को नियंत्रित किया जा
सके। कृपया इस पत्र के जारी होने की तिथि से 30 दिनों के भीतर की गई कार्यवाही रिपोर्ट (ATR) सीपीसीबी को उपलब्ध
कराना सुनिश्चित करें।

title: RTI Appeal disposed by Election Commission of India
subject: Right to Information Act, 2005-regarding.
response_summary: The CPIO initially responded by referring to an attachment. In the FAA response, it was stated that the information sought was extensive, spanning multiple files and hundreds of pages, and compiling it would disproportionately divert resources. The FAA advised the appellant to file a fresh RTI application with clear and limited points for more efficient processing, and consequently, the appeal was disposed of.

The Members of Parliament (Travelling and Daily Allowances) Rules,1957 3. The Housing and Telephone Facilites (Members of Parliament)Rules, 1956 4. The Medical Facilties (Members of Parliament) Rules, 1959 5. The Members of Parliament (Allowances for Journeys Abroad) Rules, 1960 6. The Members of Parliament (Constituency Allowance) Rules, 1986 7. The Members of Parliament (Advance for the Purchase of Conveyance) Rules, 1986 8. The Members of Parliament (Office Expense Allowance) Rules, 1988. Pension to Ex-MPs are sanctioned by the MSA Branch as per the Section 8A of the Salary, Allowances and Pension of Members of Parliament Act, 1954. The aforementioned Act/Rules are available on Lok Sabha website and can be accessed through www.loksabha.nic.in and by clicking on 'Members' slot and then on 'Salary Acts and Rules'. The applicant is advised to go through the above website of Lok Sabha for obtaining the desired information.

1. निर्वाचन होने के पश्चात् शपथ लेने की तिथि तक और शपथ लेने की तिथि से दिसम्बर 2016 तक लोक सभा के सदस्यों की चल और अचल संपत्ति के ब्यौरे से संबंधित सूचना उपलब्ध कराएं।
उत्तर: लोक सभा के प्रत्येक निर्वाचित सदस्य को शपथ लेने की तिथि से 90 दिन के अंदर लोक सभा के सदस्य (परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों की घोषणा) नियम, 2004 के अनुसार अपनी परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों से संबंधित सूचना देनी होती है। आज की तिथि तक ऐसे सदस्यों द्वारा परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों के संबंध में दिए गए घोषणा पत्र कई हजार पृष्ठों (लगभग 5000 पृष्ठ) में हैं और इनकी प्रतियां आवेदक को वांछित प्रभार/शुल्क जमा करने के पश्चात उपलब्ध कराई जाएंगी। साथ ही, यह भी सूचित किया जाता है कि आम चुनावों की प्रक्रिया के दौरान लोक सभा के निर्वाचित सदस्यों द्वारा घोषित की गई संपत्ति का ब्यौरा न तो लोक सभा सचिवालय में रखा जाता है और न ही यहां उपलब्ध है। अतः, इस संबंध में कोई सूचना उपलब्ध नहीं कराई जा सकती। भारतीय निर्वाचन आयोग को अंतरित भी किया गया है।

title: Parliament Adjournment, Expenditure and Disciplinary Action Information Sought
subject: The applicant sought information on how many times Parliament proceedings were adjourned since May 2014, per-day expenditure on sessions, money lost due to non-functioning of Parliament, Bills passed since May 2014, and disciplinary action against disruptive Members.
questions: How many times proceedings of the House adjourned after May 2014
Per day expenditure on Parliament proceedings since May 2014.
Money lost due to non functioning of Parliament during session and also provide information regarding agencies who bear such expenditure.
Furnish the number of Sessions and names of Bills passed by Lok Sabha since May, 2014 i.e., the time since NDA Government assumed Office.

The recent conflicts between the Government and the opposition over the issue of demonetisation has affected the functioning of Parliament and had caused hindrance to major developmental works of the country. Do these members get elected to Parliament for protests and demonstrations? Why disciplinary proceedings are not initiated against such members and which authority can take such an action?
response_summary: The Secretariat provided website links for adjournment and session data, explained that session expenditure is incurred by multiple agencies with no single dedicated head of account, attached an unaudited expenditure statement for FY2016-17 (up to Nov 2016), listed ten Sessions held since May 2014 with a table of Bulletin Part-II references for Bills passed, enclosed a list of Bills passed in the Tenth Session, and cited Rules 373, 374 and 374(A) empowering the Speaker to take disciplinary action against disruptive Members.

Information about the number of times Lok Sabha functioned during the 16th Lok Sabha is available under Business -> Resume of Work -> Duration of Session, and for the 10th session under Business -> Bulletin Part-I, date wise.

2. Per day expenditure on Parliament proceedings since May 2014.
Reply: The expenditure on proceedings of Parliament Session is incurred by multiple agencies viz. Lok Sabha Secretariat, Rajya Sabha Secretariat, Ministry of Urban Development (CPWD) and other Ministries/departments. There is no specific and exclusive Head of Account for booking this expenditure. However, Head of account-wise expenditure incurred [from Financial year 2009-10 to 2015-16] out of Budget Grant of Lok Sabha and booked by P&AO, Lok Sabha, is available on Lok Sabha homepage. Expenditure incurred (un-audited) from 1.4.2016 to 30.11.2016 compiled on the basis of expenditure figures furnished by P&AO, LS is enclosed (Annexure-I). Information regarding expenditure incurred by other Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat is not available with the Branch concerned.

3. Money lost due to non functioning of Parliament during session and also provide information regarding agencies who bear such expenditure.
Reply: Information regarding money lost due to non-functioning of Parliament during session and agencies who bear such expenditure is not available with the Branch concerned. The expenditure on Parliament Session proceedings is incurred by multiple agencies with no specific and exclusive Head of Account for booking such expenditure.

4. Furnish the number of Sessions and names of Bills passed by Lok Sabha since May, 2014 i.e., the time since NDA Government assumed Office.
Reply: Since May, 2014, ten Sessions of the Sixteenth Lok Sabha have been held. A statement showing Government Bills passed by the Houses and assented to in respect of each Session is published in Lok Sabha Bulletin Part-II after the conclusion of the Session; since the information is already in public domain, the applicant may browse the 'Bulletin-II' link under 'Business' on the Lok Sabha website. The applicant may refer to Bulletin Part-II paras for dates: 4.9.2014-Para 642; 6.1.2015-Para 1215; 5.6.2015-Para 1933; 16.9.2015-Para 2379; 20.1.2016-Para 2817; 31.3.2016-Para 3249; 6.6.2016-Para 3601; 12.9.2016-Para 4084. A list of Government Bills passed by Lok Sabha during the Tenth Session of the Sixteenth Lok Sabha is enclosed (Annexure-II).

5. The recent conflicts between the Government and the opposition over the issue of demonetisation has affected the functioning of Parliament and had caused hindrance to major developmental works of the country. Do these members get elected to Parliament for protests and demonstrations? Why disciplinary proceedings are not initiated against such members and which authority can take such an action?
Reply: Rule 373, 374 and 374(A) of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha provide for the withdrawal and suspension of members from the services of the House for disorderly conduct, willful obstruction of business and persistent abuse of the Rules by members. These Rules are available on the Lok Sabha website under 'Parliamentary Procedure'. Hon'ble Speaker, Lok Sabha can initiate disciplinary action against members disrupting the House; it is for the Speaker to decide.

1. दिल्ली विधानसभा के पानी और बिजली के बिल संबंधी जानकारी उपलब्ध कराएं।
उत्तर: आपके द्वारा मांगी गई जानकारी इस सचिवालय से संबंधित नहीं है बल्कि यह दिल्ली विधानसभा से संबंधित है। आपसे अनुरोध है कि आप उनसे सीधे ही संपर्क करके वांछित सूचना प्राप्त कर लें।

2. संसद सदस्यों के वस्त्रों पर हुए व्यय का ब्यौरा दें।
उत्तर: संसद सदस्य अपने वस्त्रों से संबंधित सामग्री आदि पर स्वयं व्यय करते हैं। इस संबंध में सदस्यों को लोक सभा सचिवालय से किसी भी प्रकार का भत्ता नहीं दिया जाता है।

3. प्रधानमंत्री के विदेशी दौरों पर हुए व्यय का ब्यौरा दें।
उत्तर: आवेदन की विषयवस्तु प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय से संबंधित है, जिन्हें आवेदन की एक प्रति भेज दी गई है। आपसे अनुरोध है कि आप उनसे सीधे ही संपर्क करके वांछित सूचना प्राप्त कर लें।

4. पंजाब विधानसभा के निर्वाचन पर हुए व्यय का ब्यौरा दें।
उत्तर: आपके द्वारा मांगी गई जानकारी इस सचिवालय से संबंधित नहीं है बल्कि यह पंजाब विधानसभा से संबंधित है। आरटीआई अधिनियम, 2005 के अंतर्गत कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय, कार्मिक और प्रशिक्षण विभाग के 2 जून, 2008 के कार्यालय ज्ञापन संख्या 10/2/2008-आईआर के पैरा 3(iv) में दिये गए निर्देशों के अनुसार इस लोक प्राधिकारी का कार्य आवेदन पत्र को उन्हें अंतरित करना नहीं है।
response_full_text: दिल्ली विधानसभा के पानी-बिजली बिल संबंधी जानकारी इस सचिवालय से संबंधित नहीं है, आवेदक को दिल्ली विधानसभा से सीधे संपर्क करने की सलाह दी गई। संसद सदस्यों को वस्त्रों हेतु लोक सभा सचिवालय से कोई भत्ता नहीं दिया जाता। प्रधानमंत्री के विदेशी दौरों से संबंधित जानकारी हेतु आवेदन की एक प्रति आरटीआई अधिनियम 2005 की धारा 6(3) के अंतर्गत प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय को भेजी गई है। पंजाब विधानसभा के निर्वाचन व्यय संबंधी जानकारी इस सचिवालय से संबंधित नहीं है और डीओपीटी के दिनांक 2 जून, 2008 के कार्यालय ज्ञापन के निर्देशानुसार इसे अंतरित करने का कार्य इस लोक प्राधिकारी का नहीं है।

title: MP Salary, Pension and Tax Exemption Information Sought
department: Members Salary & Allowances Branch, Lok Sabha Secretariat
subject: The applicant sought information on the salary, pension and other allowances/perquisites of Members of Parliament and whether they enjoy any tax exemption.
questions: Salary and Pension of Members of Parliament and other allowances and perquisites of MPs

1. Salary and Pension of Members of Parliament and other allowances and perquisites of MPs
Reply: The Salary and Pension of Members of Parliament and other allowances and perquisites of MPs are regulated by: 1. The Salary, Allowances and pension of Members of Parliament Act, 1954 (As amended). 2. The Members of Parliament (Travelling and Daily Allowances) Rules, 1957. 3. The Housing and Telephone Facilities (Members of Parliament) Rules, 1956. 4. The Medical Facilities (Members of Parliament) Rules, 1959. 5. The Members of Parliament (Allowances for Journeys Abroad) Rules, 1960. 6. The Members of Parliament (Constituency Allowances) Rules, 1986. 7. The Members of Parliament (Advance for the purchase of Conveyance) Rules, 1986. 8. The Members of Parliament (Office Expense Allowance) Rules, 1988. The above Act/Rules are available on the website of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha. The applicant is advised to go through the above websites for obtaining the desired information.

2. Whether they enjoy any tax exemption, if yes to what extent
Reply: The salary and allowances received by the Members are taxed under the head of Income from other sources. Since the salary and allowances are taxed under this head, such salary and allowances would not be subjected to Tax Deduction at Source (TDS). Members will have to discharge their tax liability by paying advance tax or self assessment tax.
response_full_text: The Salary and Pension of Members of Parliament and other allowances and perquisites of MPs are regulated by the Salary, Allowances and Pension of Members of Parliament Act, 1954 (as amended) and related Rules on travelling allowances, housing, medical facilities, foreign journeys, constituency allowances, conveyance advance, and office expense allowance, all available on the Lok Sabha website. The salary and allowances received by Members are taxed under the head 'Income from other sources' and are therefore not subject to Tax Deduction at Source (TDS); Members must discharge their tax liability by paying advance tax or self-assessment tax.

Therefore, the requisite information may not be furnished. Moreover, Section 7(9) of RTI Act, 2005 provides that information shall ordinarily be provided in the form in which it is sought unless it would disproportionately divert the resources of the public authority.

e) Whether the criteria of DPC for Gazetted and Non-gazetted are different? Please provide details along with the number of DPC's usually held for non-gazetted officials within a year.

To provide such information would require creating new information, which the Public Information Officer is not required to do under the DoPT Guidelines dated 28.11.2013. Therefore, the requisite information may not be furnished; Section 7(9) of the RTI Act, 2005 is also cited.

g) Give the details of promotions of Gazetted Officers in the years 2014, 2015 and 2016 and how many notification/order regarding promotions of Gazetted Officers issued in above-mentioned years.
Reply: The orders regarding promotions of employees of Lok Sabha Secretariat are uploaded on the intranet; the applicant may visit the intranet to obtain copies of all office orders/notifications issued during 2014-2016 at http://164.100.47.193/intranet/home.htm

1. How to common person directly ask Question to Parliament.
Reply: Only Members of Parliament can raise Questions in Lok Sabha. However, public can air their grievances through their elected representatives on the matters of large public interest.

2. Kindly provide information about number of youth representative (age 25 to 35) in Lok Sabha since freedom.
Reply: The information relating to Members aged between 25-35 years since the First Lok Sabha (i.e. 1952 onwards) can be accessed on the Lok Sabha website <www.loksabha.nic.in> under the heading 'Members' -> 'Member, Since 1952' -> All Members Biographical Sketches. As regards the present Lok Sabha (16th Lok Sabha), information relating to Members (aged 25-35 years) can be accessed under 'Members' -> 'Sitting Members' -> 'Member Search' -> 'Age-Wise'.

3. How to I see Parliament Session
Reply: The procedure to watch the proceedings of the Lok Sabha for a common man is that he has to fill an application form available at CPIC/Reception Office (Lok Sabha)/official website of Lok Sabha (www.parliamentofindia.nic.in), duly signed by an Hon'ble MP (Lok Sabha). The proceeding can be watched during the session period subject to availability of seats in public gallery.

Reply: Lok Sabha Secretariat does not maintain the attendance of members on the basis of maximum/minimum attendance in the House. However, an Attendance Register is maintained for members (except Hon'ble Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Prime Minister and Ministers) to sign against their names in token of having attended the sitting of the House on a particular day. Details of signing/not signing the Attendance Register by members during all sessions of the 16th Lok Sabha are available on the Lok Sabha website under 'Members' -> 'Sitting Members' -> 'Attendance of Members' -> 'Member-wise Attendance' -> 'All Members'. The applicant may, however, note that it is possible that a member attended the sitting of the House on a particular day but did not sign the Attendance Register for that day.
response_full_text: Only Members of Parliament can raise Questions in Lok Sabha. However, public can air their grievances through their elected representatives. Information relating to Members aged 25-35 years since the First Lok Sabha can be accessed on the Lok Sabha website. To watch Parliament proceedings, a common person must fill an application form at CPIC/Reception Office duly signed by an Hon'ble MP; the proceeding can be watched subject to availability of seats in the public gallery. Lok Sabha Secretariat does not maintain attendance on the basis of maximum/minimum attendance, but an Attendance Register is maintained for members to sign; details of signing/not signing are available on the Lok Sabha website. A member may have attended without signing the register on a given day.

title: केंद्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारियों एवं अपीलीय प्राधिकारियों की सूची की मांग
subject: आवेदक ने वर्ष 2005 से 2016 तक लोक सभा सचिवालय में केंद्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारी व प्रथम अपीलीय अधिकारी रहे व्यक्तियों के नाम तथा अन्य विविध विषयों पर जानकारी मांगी।
questions: 2005 से 2016 तक केन्द्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारी तथा प्रथम अपीलीय अधिकारी के पद पर रहे व्यक्तियों के नाम बताएं (बिन्दु संख्या 7)।
भारत सरकार/राज्य सरकारों/न्यायालयों द्वारा प्रयोग में लायी जा रही भाषा तथा अन्य विविध मामलों (जमीन और भ्रष्टाचार से जुड़े मामले) से संबंधित जानकारी।
response_summary: सचिवालय ने केवल बिन्दु संख्या 7 से संबंधित सूचना, यानी वर्ष 2005 से केंद्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारियों व अपीलीय प्राधिकारियों की सूची संलग्न की। शेष प्रश्न विभिन्न राज्य सरकारों/एजेंसियों से संबंधित होने के कारण डीओपीटी के निर्देशों के अनुसार अंतरित नहीं किए जा सके और आवेदक को सीधे संबंधित राज्य सरकारों से संपर्क करने की सलाह दी गई।

महोदय,

कें.ज.सू.अधि./माननीय अध्यक्ष, लोक सभा को संबोधित तथा इस सचिवालय में प्राप्त आपके आर टी आई आवेदन पत्र, जिसमें 2005 से 2016 तक केन्द्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारी तथा प्रथम अपीलीय अधिकारी के पद पर रहे व्यक्तियों के नाम, भारत सरकार/राज्य सरकारों/न्यायालयों द्वारा प्रयोग में लायी जा रही भाषा तथा अन्य विविध मामलों (जमीन और भ्रष्टाचार से जुड़े मामले) आदि से संबंधित जानकारी मांगी गयी है, के संबंध में मुझे यह कहने का निदेश हुआ है कि आवेदन पत्र के केवल बिन्दु संख्या 7 में मांगी गयी केंद्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारियों और प्रथम अपीलीय अधिकारियों के नामों की सूची से संबंधित जानकारी ही लोक सभा सचिवालय से संबंधित है और उक्त जानकारी इस पत्र के साथ संलग्न कर दी गयी है।

2. आवेदन पत्र के अन्य प्रश्न लोक सभा सचिवालय से संबंधित न होकर विभिन्न संगठनों/एजेंसियों/राज्य सरकारों से संबंधित हैं। कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय, कार्मिक और प्रशिक्षण विभाग के कार्यालय ज्ञापन सं. 10/2/2008-आईआर दिनांक 12.06.2008 और 21.09.2010 के अंतर्गत दिए गए निर्देशों के अनुसार आपके आवेदन को अंतरित नहीं किया जा सकता है, जिसमें कहा गया है कि 'यदि कोई व्यक्ति किसी लोक प्राधिकारी को ऐसी जानकारी के लिए आवेदन भेजता है जो किसी राज्य सरकार या संघ राज्य क्षेत्र के प्रशासन के अंतर्गत लोक प्राधिकारी से संबंधित है, तो आवेदन प्राप्त करने वाले लोक प्राधिकारी के केंद्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारी को चाहिए कि वह आवेदक को सूचित करे कि वह वांछित जानकारी संबंधित राज्य सरकार/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र प्रशासन से प्राप्त करे। ऐसी स्थिति में आवेदन राज्य सरकार/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र के प्रशासन को अंतरित करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।'

3. अतः, आपको सलाह दी जाती है कि आप विभिन्न राज्य सरकारों और लोक प्राधिकारियों से संपर्क करें और उनसे सीधे जानकारी प्राप्त करें।

4. 10/- रूपये के आवेदन शुल्क की रसीद सं. 4676 दिनांक 20.12.2016 इस पत्र के साथ संलग्न है।

5. इसे कें.ज.सू.अधि. का अनुमोदन प्राप्त है।

title: Query on Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill Classification and Voting Procedure
subject: The applicant sought clarification on the constitutional basis for classifying the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 as a Financial Bill and on the procedure for division/voting on Bills in the Lok Sabha.
questions: Furnish the set of evidential documents of the mentioned issue with reference to the Constitution of India that when the Bill, the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill-2014, for the formation of Telangana-Region as Separate/New State/29th State, is prepared with reference to the provisions of the Article-3 of the Constitution and the same is required to be produced in the Parliament as a CONSTITUTION AMENDMENT BILL, after referring to President's Recommendations, and AGAIN taking the President's Recommendations under the guise of the clauses which indirectly linked with expenditures affected the provisions of the Article 117(1) Or 117(3) of the Constitution, is just confined to the exclusive purpose that the said Bill prepared as Constitutional Amendment Bill, has to be submitted in Lok Sabha as a Financial Bill. Under which provisional ground the original Characteristics of the said Bill prepared as Constitution Amendment Bill will be changed/converted to a Financial Bill.
Under which provision/ground the speaker of the Lok-Sabha declares that the said bill is Passed, without Conducting the process of Division / Voting difference in figures against yes /no equation.
response_summary: The Secretariat clarified that the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 was classified as a Financial Bill under Articles 117(1) and 117(3), and that under Article 4(2) such State reorganisation Bills are not deemed constitutional amendments under Article 368. It also explained that motions on Bills are normally decided by voice vote, with division undertaken only if a Member insists and the Speaker approves; division on this Bill was held on 18.02.2014, details of which are on the Lok Sabha website.

Information Sought: Furnish the set of evidential documents of the mentioned issue with reference to the Constitution of India that when the Bill, the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill-2014, for the formation of Telangana-Region as Separate/New State/29th State, is prepared with reference to the provisions of the Article-3 of the Constitution and the same is required to be produced in the Parliament as a CONSTITUTION AMENDMENT BILL, after referring to President's Recommendations, and AGAIN taking the President's Recommendations under the guise of the clauses which indirectly linked with expenditures affected the provisions of the Article 117(1) Or 117(3) of the Constitution, is just confined to the exclusive purpose that the said Bill prepared as Constitutional Amendment Bill, has to be submitted in Lok Sabha as a Financial Bill. Under which provisional ground the original Characteristics of the said Bill prepared as Constitution Amendment Bill will be changed/converted to a Financial Bill.
Reply: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 was classified as Financial Bill under article 117(1) and 117(3). The applicant may further be informed that as per article 4(2) of the Constitution, a Bill relating to admission or establishment of new States, formation of new States and alteration of areas, boundaries or names of existing States and providing for amendment of the First and the Fourth Schedule to the Constitution is not deemed to be an amendment of the Constitution for the purposes of article 368. The applicant is requested to go through the provisions of articles 2, 3 and 4 of the Constitution for further clarification.

Question: Under which provision/ground the speaker of the Lok-Sabha declares that the said bill is Passed, without Conducting the process of Division / Voting difference in figures against yes /no equation.
Reply: The motion that a Bill be taken into consideration or that the Bill be passed, in respect of a Bill other than a Constitution Amendment Bill, is decided normally by voice vote. However, if any Member insists for division, then the process of division may be undertaken with the approval of Hon'ble Speaker. There are several provisions like rule 367, 367A, 367AA, 367B (of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha that is available in the website link www.loksabha.nic.in -> procedures) etc. that deal with Division in Lok Sabha. This branch conducts with the division (on the Bills) in Lok Sabha: Division/Voting was held on 'The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014' on 18.02.2014, details of which are available on the website of Lok Sabha i.e. www.loksabha.nic.in under the heading Debates -> Text of Debate -> 15th Lok Sabha -> XV session. It may be pointed out that without conducting the process, never the result of the division has been declared, as asked by the applicant.

The applicant is requested to go through the provisions of articles 2, 3 and 4 of the Constitution for further clarification. The motion that a Bill be taken into consideration or that the Bill be passed, in respect of a Bill other than a Constitution Amendment Bill, is decided normally by voice vote. However, if any Member insists for division, then the process of division may be undertaken with the approval of Hon'ble Speaker. There are several provisions like rule 367, 367A, 367AA, 367B that deal with Division in Lok Sabha. Division/Voting was held on 'The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014' on 18.02.2014, details of which are available on the website of Lok Sabha under the heading Debates -> Text of Debate -> 15th Lok Sabha -> XV session. It may be pointed out that without conducting the process, never the result of the division has been declared, as asked by the applicant.

Reply: The expenditure on proceedings of Parliament Session is incurred by multiple agencies viz. Lok Sabha Secretariat, Rajya Sabha Secretariat, Ministry of Urban Development (CPWD) and other Ministries/departments. There is no specific and exclusive Head of Account for booking the expenditure incurred by various Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat etc. in connection with the conduct of Parliament. However, Head of account-wise expenditure (including subsidy on food) incurred [from Financial year 2009-10 to 2015-16] out of Budget Grant of Lok Sabha and booked by P&AO, Lok Sabha, is available on Lok Sabha homepage under link: http://164.100.47.192/loksabha/Secretariat/DemandLokSabha.aspx. Expenditure for the month of September, 2016 is yet to be compiled. Information regarding expenditure incurred by other Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat is not available with Branch concerned of the Secretariat i.e. Integrated Finance Unit.

2. What amount spent on MPs food, travelling, residence etc. for one day.
Reply: Food is not provided to MPs by the Government/Lok Sabha Secretariat. Canteens are run in the Parliament Complex by Northern Railways. Members utilise these canteens and take food on a payment basis. Travelling Allowance of Members is governed by the Salary, Allowances and Pension of Members of Parliament Act, 1954 and rules made thereunder. There is no provision in the Act for maintaining the information desired by the applicant. Therefore MSA Branch does not maintain such record. Other aspects do not pertain to this branch. संदर्भ: लोक सभा सचिवालय पत्र सं. 1(2141)/आईसी/16 दिनांक 02.01.2017

क्रम सं.1: लोक सभा चुनाव वर्ष 2014 में हुए थे। लोक सभा सदस्यों द्वारा चुनाव के समय प्रस्तुत किए गए अपने शपथ पत्रों में संपत्ति, नकद धनराशि, आभूषण और वाहनों के संबंध में दी गई जानकारी प्रदान करें।
उत्तर: संबंधित शाखा अर्थात विशेषाधिकार और आचार शाखा ने यह बताया है कि आम चुनावों के दौरान निर्वाचित लोक सभा सदस्यों द्वारा प्रस्तुत शपथ पत्रों का लोक सभा सचिवालय न तो रख-रखाव किया जाता है और न ही वे में उपलब्ध हैं। अतः, इस संबंध में कोई जानकारी उपलब्ध नहीं कराई जा सकती। आवेदन भारत निर्वाचन आयोग से संबंधित प्रतीत होता है जहां आवेदन की प्रति प्रेषित की जा चुकी है। आपसे अनुरोध है कि आप सीधे उनसे संपर्क करें।

क्रम सं.2: लोक सभा सदस्यों द्वारा शपथ ग्रहण से लेकर आजतक संपत्ति, नकद धनराशि, आभूषण तथा वाहनों के संबंध में दी गई जानकारी प्रदान करें।
उत्तर: लोक सभा सदस्यों को लोक सभा के सदस्य (परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों की घोषणा) नियम, 2004 के अनुसार अपनी परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों के संबंध में घोषणा पत्र देना होता है। आज की तिथि तक ऐसे सदस्यों द्वारा परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों के संबंध में दिए गए घोषणा पत्र कई हजार पृष्ठों (लगभग 5000 पृष्ठ) में हैं और इसकी प्रतियां आवेदक को आवश्यक प्रभार/शुल्क जमा करने के पश्चात उपलब्ध कराई जाएंगी।

टिप्पणी: यदि आप चाहते हैं कि आपको वांछित सूचना भेज दी जाए तो इसके लिए सूचना शुल्क के रूप में (2/- रुपये प्रति पृष्ठ की दर से) कुल 10,000/- रुपये जमा करें। लोक सभा सचिवालय सूचना का अधिकार (शुल्क और लागत का विनियमन) नियम, 2005 और संशोधन नियम, 2007 के अनुसार सूचना शुल्क का भुगतान संसदीय ज्ञानपीठ, के स्वागत कार्यालय, लोक सभा सचिवालय में नकद रूप में रसीद प्राप्त करके अथवा आहरण और संवितरण अधिकारी, लोक सभा को देय मनीऑर्डर या डिमांड ड्राफ्ट या बैंकर चैक या भारतीय पोस्टल ऑर्डर के रूप में किया जाना अपेक्षित है।
response_full_text: संबंधित शाखा अर्थात विशेषाधिकार और आचार शाखा ने बताया है कि आम चुनावों के दौरान निर्वाचित लोक सभा सदस्यों द्वारा प्रस्तुत शपथ पत्रों का लोक सभा सचिवालय न तो रख-रखाव करता है और न ही वे उपलब्ध हैं; आवेदन भारत निर्वाचन आयोग से संबंधित प्रतीत होता है जहां आवेदन की प्रति प्रेषित की जा चुकी है। लोक सभा सदस्यों को लोक सभा के सदस्य (परिसंपत्तियों और दायित्वों की घोषणा) नियम, 2004 के अनुसार घोषणा पत्र देना होता है; ऐसे घोषणा पत्र लगभग 5000 पृष्ठों में हैं और शुल्क (2/- रुपये प्रति पृष्ठ, कुल 10,000/- रुपये) जमा करने पर प्रतियां उपलब्ध कराई जाएंगी।

1. Total money spent on Parliament Session during 2015-16 and subsidy given, and also the number of hours it was supposed to work and it actually worked.
Reply: The expenditure on proceedings of Parliament Session is incurred by multiple agencies viz. Lok Sabha Secretariat, Rajya Sabha Secretariat, Ministry of Urban Development (CPWD) and other Ministries/departments. There is no specific and exclusive Head of Account for booking the expenditure incurred by various Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat etc. in connection with the conduct of Parliament. However, Head of account-wise expenditure (including subsidy on food) incurred [from Financial year 2009-10 to 2015-16] out of Budget Grant of Lok Sabha and booked by P&AO, Lok Sabha, is available on Lok Sabha homepage under link: http://164.100.47.192/loksabha/Secretariat/DemandLokSabha.aspx. Expenditure incurred (un-audited) from 1.4.2016 to 31.8.2016 compiled on the basis of expenditure figures furnished by P&AO, LS is enclosed (Annexure-I). Expenditure for the month of September, 2016 is yet to be compiled. Information regarding expenditure incurred by other Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat is not available with Branch concerned of the Secretariat i.e. Integrated Finance Unit.

2. Total amount of subsidy given to canteen in Parliament premises.
Reply: The subsidy claimed on account of provision for the year 2015-16 is enclosed. Also partially transferred to Ministry of Railways on 24.12.2016.

3. Provide information on loss of public money due to adjournment of proceedings of House during session.
Reply: Please see reply to point no.1.

Reply: Information to query relating to working days of Lok Sabha is available in the Lok Sabha website, viz. loksabha.nic.in -> 'Business' -> 'Resume of Work'. 2. Kindly provide the information regarding the total attendance of Smt. Sonia Gandhi and Shri Rahul Gandhi during 13th, 14th, 15th and 16th Lok Sabhas (upto 12th December, 2016).
Reply: An attendance Register is maintained for members (except Hon'ble Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Prime Minister and Ministers) to sign against their names in token of having attended the sitting of the House on a particular day. Details of signing/not signing the Attendance Register by members of Lok Sabha during all the sessions of 14th, 15th & 16th Lok Sabhas are available on the website of the Lok Sabha i.e., www.loksabha.nic.in under the headings Members->Attendance of Members->Member-wise Attendance -> All Members respectively. title: Constitutional Classification of AP Reorganisation Bill as Financial Bill
department: सूचना प्रकोष्ठ (Information Cell), Lok Sabha Secretariat
subject: RTI seeking clarification on the constitutional basis for classifying the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 as a Financial Bill and the process of its passing without division.
questions: Furnish the set of evidential documents of the mentioned issue with reference to the Constitution of India that when the Bill, the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill-2014, for the formation of Telangana-Region as Separate/New State/29ti State, is prepared with reference to the provisions of the Article-3 of the Constitution and the same is required to be produced in the Parliament as a CONSTITUTION AMENDMENT BILL, after referring to President's Recommendations, and AGAIN taking the President's Recommendations under the guise of the clauses which indirectly linked with expenditures affected the provisions of the Article 117(1) Or 117(3) of the Constitution, is just confined to the exclusive purpose that the said Bill prepared as Constitutional Amendment Bill, has to be submitted in Lok Sabha as a Financial Bill, (1) Under which provisional ground the original Characteristics of the said Bill prepared as Constitution Amendment Bill will be changed/converted to a Financial Bill. (2) Under which provision/ground the speaker of the Lok-Sabha declares that the said bill is Passed, without Conducting the process of Division / Voting difference in figures against yes /no equation
response_summary: The Secretariat explained that the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 was classified as a Financial Bill under Articles 117(1) and 117(3), and that under Article 4(2) a Bill relating to formation/alteration of States is not deemed a Constitutional amendment; it further explained that Bills (other than Constitution Amendment Bills) are normally passed by voice vote, with division undertaken only with the Speaker's approval if a Member insists.

3. कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय के कार्यालय ज्ञापन सं. 10/2/2008-आईआर दिनांक 12.06.2008 और 24.09.2010 के अनुसार आपका आवेदन पत्र उक्त प्राधिकारियों को अंतरित नहीं किया जा सकता, जिसमें यह कहा गया है कि यदि कोई व्यक्ति किसी लोक प्राधिकरण से ऐसी सूचना मांगता है जो किसी राज्य सरकार या संघ राज्य क्षेत्र प्रशासन के लोक प्राधिकरण से संबंधित है, तो आवेदन प्राप्त करने वाले केन्द्रीय जन सूचना अधिकारी द्वारा आवेदक को सूचित कर दिया जाना चाहिए कि सूचना संबंधित राज्य सरकार/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र के प्रशासन से प्राप्त की जा सकती है। ऐसी स्थिति में आवेदन पत्र को राज्य सरकार/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र प्रशासन को अंतरित करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
4. आपको सलाह दी जाती है कि आप अनुसूचित जाति एवं अनुसूचित जनजाति संबंधी राष्ट्रीय आयोग और मध्य प्रदेश सरकार के संबंधित मंत्रालय से सीधे संपर्क करें और वांछित जानकारी प्राप्त करें।
5. इसे कें.ज.सू.अधि. का अनुमोदन प्राप्त है।
भवदीय,
सद्/-
उप सचिव एवं कें.स.ज.सू. अ.

title: First Lok Sabha formation, MP salary history and precedence rules queried
subject: The applicant sought information on the formation of the first Lok Sabha, MPs' salary/allowance history, warrant of precedence, MPLAD funds, number of cabinet ministers, joint committee composition, best parliamentarian award, and MPs who became Prime Minister.
questions: कृपया भारत की स्वतंत्रता के पश्चात् पहली लोक सभा के गठन की तिथि बताएं।
पहली लोक सभा के निर्वाचित सदस्यों की संख्या बताएं।
पहली लोक सभा के सदस्यों को दिए गए वेतन और भत्ते तथा पहली लोक सभा से वर्तमान लोक सभा तक संसद सदस्यों के वेतन/भत्तों में वृद्धि और परिवर्तन बताएं।
वर्तमान संसद सदस्यों के वेतन व भत्ते किन अधिनियमों/नियमों द्वारा विनियमित किए जाते हैं?
संसद के सदस्यों के नयाचार नियमों से संबंधित जानकारी प्रदान करें।
पहली लोक सभा से वर्तमान लोक सभा तक संसद सदस्यों को प्रदान किए गए एम.पी. लैड निधि की जानकारी दें।
लोक सभा केबिनेट मंत्रियों एवं वर्तमान में केबिनेट मंत्रियों और राज्य मंत्रियों की संख्या बताएं।

आवेदक का नाम: [Applicant]
आवेदन की तिथि: 18.11.2016
संदर्भ: लोक सभा सचिवालय पत्र सं. 1(2036)/आईसी/16 दिनांक 03.01.2017

1. कृपया भारत की स्वतंत्रता के पश्चात् पहली लोक सभा के गठन की तिथि बताएं।
   उत्तर: पहली लोक सभा का गठन 17.04.1952 को हुआ था।
2. पहली लोक सभा के निर्वाचित सदस्यों की संख्या बताएं।
   उत्तर: पहली लोक सभा के गठन के समय 489 सदस्य निर्वाचित हुए थे।
3. पहली लोक सभा के सदस्यों को दिए गए वेतन और भत्ते तथा पहली लोक सभा से वर्तमान लोक सभा तक संसद सदस्यों के वेतन/भत्तों में वृद्धि और परिवर्तन बताएं।
   उत्तर: पहली लोक सभा के संसद सदस्यों का वेतन 400/- रूपये प्रतिमाह और दैनिक भत्ता 21/- रूपये प्रतिदिन तथा यात्रा भत्ता 0.50 रूपये प्रति किमी था। समय समय पर संसद सदस्यों के वेतन में वृद्धि होती रही है। संशोधित वेतन का विवरण इस प्रकार है: 1. जून 1954 में 400/- रूपये, 2. 01.6.1961 से 500/- रूपये, 3. 30.8.1983 से 750/- रूपये, 4. 26.12.1985 से 1000/- रूपये, 5. 01.1.1988 से 1500/- रूपये, 6. 20.8.1998 से 4000/- रूपये, 7. 14.9.2001 से 12000/- रूपये, 8. 14.9.2006 से 16000/- रूपये, 9. 18.5.2009 से 50000/- रूपये।
4. वर्तमान संसद सदस्यों के वेतन व भत्ते किन अधिनियमों/नियमों द्वारा विनियमित किए जाते हैं?
   उत्तर: संसद सदस्यों के वेतन और भत्तों को निम्नलिखित यथासंशोधित अधिनियम/नियमों द्वारा विनियमित किया जाता है: 1. संसद सदस्य वेतन, भत्ता और पेंशन अधिनियम, 1954 (यथा संशोधित) 2. संसद सदस्य (यात्रा और दैनिक भत्ते) नियम, 1957 3. आवास और टेलीफोन सुविधाएं (संसद सदस्य) नियम, 1956 4. चिकित्सा सुविधाएं (संसद सदस्य) नियम, 1959 5. संसद सदस्य (विदेश यात्रा के लिए भत्ते) नियम, 1986 6. संसद सदस्य (निर्वाचन क्षेत्र संबंधी भत्ता) नियम, 1960 7. संसद सदस्य (वाहन क्रय अग्रिम) नियम, 1986 8. संसद सदस्य (कार्यालय व्यय भत्ता) नियम, 1988। उपर्युक्त अधिनियम/नियम लोक सभा की वेबसाइट पर उपलब्ध हैं (www.loksabha.nic.in - Members - Salary Acts and Rules)।
5. संसद के सदस्यों के नयाचार नियमों से संबंधित जानकारी प्रदान करें।
   उत्तर: राष्ट्रपति सचिवालय द्वारा जारी अग्रता अधिपत्र (Warrant of Precedence) में संसद सदस्यों को क्रम सं. 21 पर रखा गया है। गृह मंत्रालय की वेबसाइट पर अग्रता अधिपत्र की प्रति उपलब्ध है।
6. पहली लोक सभा से वर्तमान लोक सभा तक संसद सदस्यों को प्रदान किए गए एम.पी. लैड निधि की जानकारी दें।
   उत्तर: दिनांक 30.11.2016 के पत्र के माध्यम से सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय को अंतरित।
7. लोक सभा केबिनेट मंत्रियों एवं वर्तमान में केबिनेट मंत्रियों और राज्य मंत्रियों की संख्या बताएं।
   उत्तर: स्वागत कार्यालय, संसद भवन, लोक सभा सचिवालय के विक्रय पटल पर बिक्री के लिए उपलब्ध प्रकाशन 'मंत्रिपरिषद 1947-2014' मूल्य 100/- रूपये (हिंदी और अंग्रेजी) की ओर ध्यान आकर्षित किया जाता है, जिसमें 15 अगस्त 1947 से 31 मार्च 2014 तक के केन्द्रीय मंत्री परिषद के सदस्यों के नाम और उनके विभाग दिए गए हैं; संख्या-वार जानकारी उपलब्ध नहीं है। वांछित जानकारी हेतु मंत्रिमंडल सचिवालय को दिनांक 06.12.2016 के पत्र के माध्यम से अंतरित।
8. उन माननीय सदस्यों के नाम और लोक सभा में उनका कार्यकाल बताएं, जिनके द्वारा लोक सभा के सदस्यों के वेतन में वृद्धि करने का प्रस्ताव सभा में पेश किया गया।
   उत्तर: प्रश्न अस्पष्ट है; तथापि संसद सदस्य वेतन, भत्ते और पेंशन अधिनियम, 1954 की धारा 9 के तहत गठित संयुक्त समिति (जिसमें राज्य सभा से 5 सदस्य और लोक सभा से 10 सदस्य होते हैं) का वर्तमान गठन दिया गया है: अध्यक्ष- श्री योगी आदित्यनाथ; लोक सभा से अन्य सदस्य तथा राज्य सभा से सदस्य भी सूचीबद्ध हैं।
9. पहली से वर्तमान लोक सभा तक श्रेष्ठ सांसद पुरस्कार के लिए चयनित संसद सदस्यों के नाम और उनका कार्यकाल बताएं।
   उत्तर: मांगी गई जानकारी संलग्न है।
10. पहली से वर्तमान लोक सभा के उन संसद सदस्यों का विवरण दें जो प्रधानमंत्री बने।
   उत्तर: दिनांक 30.11.2016 के पत्र के माध्यम से प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय को अंतरित।

[नोट: यह अभिलेख स्कैन किए गए दस्तावेज़ के ओसीआर पाठ से निकाला गया है; कुछ अंकों/शब्दों में पहचान त्रुटियां हो सकती हैं।]
response_full_text: पहली लोक सभा का गठन 17.04.1952 को हुआ था; गठन के समय 489 सदस्य निर्वाचित हुए थे। पहली लोक सभा के संसद सदस्यों का वेतन 400/- रूपये प्रतिमाह था, जिसमें समय-समय पर वृद्धि होती रही (1954 में 400/-, 1961 से 500/-, 1983 से 750/-, 1985 से 1000/-, 1988 से 1500/-, 1998 से 4000/-, 2001 से 12000/-, 2006 से 16000/-, 2009 से 50000/- रूपये)। वेतन व भत्ते संसद सदस्य वेतन, भत्ता और पेंशन अधिनियम, 1954 सहित विभिन्न नियमों द्वारा विनियमित होते हैं, जो लोक सभा वेबसाइट पर उपलब्ध हैं। संसद सदस्यों को अग्रता अधिपत्र में क्रम संख्या 21 पर रखा गया है। एम.पी. लैड निधि संबंधी जानकारी सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय को अंतरित की गई। केबिनेट मंत्रियों की संख्या हेतु प्रकाशन 'मंत्रिपरिषद 1947-2014' का संदर्भ दिया गया एवं शेष जानकारी हेतु मंत्रिमंडल सचिवालय को अंतरित किया गया। संसद सदस्य वेतन वृद्धि हेतु गठित संयुक्त समिति की वर्तमान संरचना दी गई। श्रेष्ठ सांसद पुरस्कार संबंधी जानकारी संलग्न की गई। प्रधानमंत्री बनने वाले सांसदों का विवरण प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय को अंतरित किया गया।

title: अविधिमान्य शुल्क के कारण आरटीआई आवेदन अंतरित नहीं किया गया
ministry: कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय / Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development
subject: ललितपुर जिले से संबंधित कृषि एवं ग्रामीण विकास विषयक जानकारी हेतु आरटीआई आवेदन, जिसका शुल्क अविधिमान्य पाए जाने के कारण आगे अंतरित नहीं किया जा सका।
questions: ललितपुर जिला और उससे संबंधित प्रश्नों के बारे में जानकारी (मूल आवेदन में विस्तृत रूप से उल्लिखित, इस पत्र में संक्षेप में उपलब्ध नहीं)
response_summary: सचिवालय ने बताया कि आवेदक द्वारा भेजा गया शुल्क अविधिमान्य है क्योंकि वह आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी, लोक सभा के खाते में देय नहीं है; साथ ही आवेदन की विषयवस्तु कृषि एवं ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय तथा राज्य सरकार से संबंधित होने के कारण इसे अंतरित नहीं किया जा सका। अविधिमान्य 10 रुपये का डाक आदेश वापस कर दिया गया और आवेदक को संबंधित लोक प्राधिकारी से सीधे संपर्क करने की सलाह दी गई।

subject: Query regarding the reasons for referring the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 to the President twice under Articles 3 and 110 of the Constitution.

title: Internal Note Clarifying MP's Status Under RTI Act, 2005
department: सूचना प्रकोष्ठ (Information Cell), Lok Sabha Secretariat
subject: An internal Information Cell note clarifying, based on a CIC decision, whether an individual Member of Parliament is covered within the meaning of the Right to Information Act, 2005.
questions: Clarification regarding whether a Member of Parliament is covered within the meaning of Right to Information Act, 2005.
response_summary: Citing CIC decision No.CIC/WB/A/2009/0007 dated 07.02.2008, the note clarified that individual MPs, MLAs, Councillors, or Panchayat members cannot themselves be deemed public authorities, though the organisations/Committees in which they fulfil constitutional obligations are public authorities; hence an MP individually is not covered under the RTI Act, 2005.

INFORMATION CELL
(FB-074, P.L.B.)

Subject: Clarification regarding whether a Member of Parliament is covered within the meaning of Right to Information Act, 2005.

Reference: Note from Office of Chairperson, Committee on Defence dated 7.7.2016.

In this connection, it may be stated that as per CIC 'A' decision/Complaint No.CIC/WB/A/2009/0007 dated 07.02.2008 & CIC/WB/C/2008/00042 Right to Information Act, 2005 - Section 7B has inter-alia decided:
XXX XXX XXX XXXX
that individuals whether MPs, MLAs, Councillors or members of Panchayats cannot in themselves be deemed public authorities. Nevertheless, the organisations and Committees in which they fulfill their obligations under the Constitution are indeed organisations defined as public authorities.

department: सूचना प्रकोष्ठ (Information Cell), Lok Sabha Secretariat
subject: The RTI sought information on programmes providing citizens practical experience of Parliamentary working, including internships with Members and Committees.
questions: Provisions made to give practical experience of Parliamentary working to citizens of country.
Information regarding internship or any other kind of short time working available to work with Members of both the Houses or their offices or into the office of any House.

response_summary: The Secretariat detailed that the Bureau of Parliamentary Studies and Training (BPST) organizes training programmes, study visits, and one-month and three-month internship programmes (25 interns each) for students, including attachment with Parliamentary Committees, though Committee meetings remain in camera and accessible only to Secretariat staff and invited officials.

title: अविधिमान्य आवेदन शुल्क के कारण RTI आवेदन वापस
department: सूचना प्रकोष्ठ (Information Cell), लोक सभा सचिवालय
subject: पारित विधेयकों और उनसे संबंधित प्रश्नों का ब्यौरा मांगने वाले RTI आवेदन का शुल्क अविधिमान्य पाए जाने पर आवेदन वापस भेजा गया।
questions: पारित विधेयक और इससे सम्बंधित प्रश्नों का ब्यौरा मांगा गया है।
response_summary: सचिवालय ने बताया कि आवेदक द्वारा भेजा गया 10 रुपये का आई पी ओ नई दिल्ली में देय न होने के कारण अविधिमान्य है, इसलिए इसे वापस भेजा जा रहा है और विधिमान्य शुल्क प्राप्त होने पर ही सूचना प्रदान की जाएगी।
rti_act_sections: लोक सभा सचिवालय सूचना का अधिकार (शुल्क और लागत का विनियमन) नियम, 2005
extracted_text:

विषय: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम, 2005 के अंतर्गत सूचना प्रदान करना।

महोदय,
इस सचिवालय में दिनांक 07.11.2016 को प्राप्त आपके दिनांक 03.10.2016 के आवेदन जिसमें पारित विधेयक और इससे सम्बंधित प्रश्नों का ब्यौरा मांगा गया है, के सन्दर्भ में मुझे यह बताने का निदेश हुआ है कि आपके द्वारा आई पी ओ संख्या 38एफ 684987 के माध्यम से भेजा गया 10 रूपये का आवेदन शुल्क नई दिल्ली में देय न होने के कारण अविधिमान्य है और इसे वापस भेजा जाता है। आपके आवेदन पर इस सचिवालय के संबंधित प्रभाग में कार्रवाई की जा रही है और विधिमान्य आवेदन शुल्क प्राप्त होने के पश्चात् आपको वांछित जानकारी प्रदान कर दी जाएगी।

2. इस सचिवालय से संबंधित कोई सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए लोक सभा सचिवालय सूचना का अधिकार (शुल्क और लागत का विनियमन) नियम, 2005 और संशोधन नियम, 2007 के अनुसार आवेदन शुल्क का भुगतान ज्ञानपीठ, लोक सभा सचिवालय के स्वागत कार्यालय में नकद रूप में रसीद प्राप्त करके अथवा आहरण और संवितरण अधिकारी, लोक सभा को देय मनीऑर्डर या डिमांड ड्राफ्ट या बैंकर चैक या भारतीय पोस्टल ऑर्डर के रूप में किया जाना अपेक्षित है। आपको यह भी सूचित किया जाता है कि लेखा अधिकारी, लोक सभा के पक्ष में डिमांड ड्राफ्ट/बैंकर चैक और भारतीय पोस्टल ऑर्डर भी इस सचिवालय में स्वीकार किया जाता है।

response_full_text: The detail of inscriptions/sutras displayed in the Parliament House is available in the brochure brought out by the PPR Section, which is available in the Lok Sabha web site under the heading "About Parliament/Education." Relevant information obtained from several books and other related literature available in Parliament Library and information supplied by Dr. R.K. Bansal, General Secretary of the All India Digambar Jain Parishad, in his correspondence, was placed before the Parliament Museum Committee. The Committee, after discussing the matter, recommended that the information desired by the All India Digambar Jain Parishad may be appropriately incorporated in the multimedia presentation. The recommendation of the Parliament Museum Committee was approved by the then Secretary-General and appropriate action was accordingly taken by the Parliament Museum.

response_full_text: interstatecouncil.nic.in पर दी गई जानकारी के अनुसार अब तक अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत आपातकाल की उद्घोषणा तीन बार जारी की गई है। ये आपातकाल निम्नलिखित अवधि के दौरान लागू रहे: (क) अक्तूबर, 1962 से जनवरी, 1968 तक; (ख) दिसम्बर, 1971 से मार्च, 1977 तक (दोनों बार विदेशी आक्रमण के कारण); और (ग) जून, 1975 से मार्च, 1977 तक (आंतरिक अशांति के कारण)। शाखा में उपलब्ध रिकार्ड के अनुसार उस अवधि के दौरान जब उपर्युक्त उद्घोषणाएं लागू थीं, भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संविधान में 27 बार संशोधन किया गया, जिसमें संविधान (तेरहवां संशोधन) अधिनियम, 1962 से लेकर संविधान (बयालीसवां संशोधन) अधिनियम, 1976 तक शामिल हैं। पूछे गए प्रश्न संविधान के विभिन्न प्रावधानों और संविधान में प्रयोग किए गए शब्दों की व्याख्या से संबंधित हैं। विषयवस्तु लोक सभा सचिवालय से संबंधित नहीं थी बल्कि वह गृह मंत्रालय एवं विधि और न्याय मंत्रालय से संबंधित थी। अतः उसे आवेदक को सूचित करते हुए 27.10.2016 को उपर्युक्त मंत्रालयों को अंतरित कर दिया गया था।

It is stated that apparently there is no single public authority which may be in custody of the requisite information. Law and order is a state subject and cases against Members may be registered in various Police Stations and may be pending in various courts of the country. उत्तर: श्री आत्मादास, मध्य प्रदेश के मुरैना संसदीय निर्वाचन क्षेत्र से 04.03.1967 से 27.12.1970 तक चौथी लोक सभा के सदस्य रहे।
बिंदु 2. क्या स्वर्गीय श्री आत्मादास, पूर्व संसद सदस्य ने संविधान (चौबीसवां संशोधन) विधेयक, 1971 के लिए हुए मतदान में भाग लिया था? जिस बहुमत के साथ संविधान (चौबीसवां संशोधन) विधेयक, 1971 पारित किया गया कृपया उसका ब्यौरा प्रदान करें।

subject: The applicant asked whether Lok Sabha authorities had investigated who forged questions in the name of former MP Shri Ramsevak Singh, given that the relevant inquiry committee had not identified the culprit.
questions: Has the Hon'ble Speaker Lok Sabha, Secretary-General or anybody from Lok Sabha tried to find out that who has forged the Questions on the name of Shri Ramsevak Singh because Committee to Inquire into allegation of improper conduct on the part of some Members has not tried to find out the culprit. Sl. No. 1: Information on the Committee on Govt. Assurances
Reply: The Committee on Government Assurances is an innovation of Indian Parliament. It is a common belief that parliamentary procedure in India is akin to that of British Parliament. While there is a lot in common between the two systems, the Indian system has undergone several changes and innovations to secure accountability of the Executive to the Parliament. One such innovation is the institutionalization of the procedure to ensure the fulfillment of promises and undertakings given from time to time by the Ministers on the floor of the House. While replying to questions in the House or during discussions on Bills, resolutions, motions, etc., Ministers sometimes give Assurances, undertakings or promises either to consider a matter, take action or furnish information to the House later. In order to watch the implementation of such Assurances on behalf of Lok Sabha, the Rules of Procedure provide for the constitution of a Committee, known as the Committee on Government Assurances, by the Speaker.
Sl. No. 2: Information on one of the States had 93 Ministers in its Council of Minister at one point of time
Reply: Subject matter does not relates to Lok Sabha Sectt. Since that the applicant stated that it is one of the State which means applicant must be aware of the same. Reply: Does not relates to Lok Sabha Secretariat, but relate to Election Commission of India where application has already been transferred by the Department of Administrative Reforms & PG on 14.10.2016

title: RTI Query on Rotaprint Bindery Store Stock Discrepancies
subject: The RTI sought details about surplus stationery/cloth items found in the Rotaprint/Bindery Store, officer accountability, stock reconciliation and Daily Output Register maintenance in the Lok Sabha Secretariat's Rotaprint Section.
questions: Since there is no Director in Printing & Publication Service presently, who is the competent authority to approve and reply information under the Right to Information Act 2005?

Shri Shovan Chaudhary, then Printing Assistant (now Sr. printing Assistant) in his note dated 4-9-2012 (copy enclosed) prepared a list of total 13 items (09 stationery Items of Rotaprint Section and 04 cloth items of Bindery Section), and remarked that these items which were kept in the Screen Printing Room of Rotaprint Section (Now occupied by JD(Ptg.)) were not related to Rotaprint/Bindery Store.
Who was the Officer-in-charge of the Rotaprint/Bindery Store at that time? Who kept the second/duplicate keys of the Rotaprint/Bindery Store?
Who was the Officer-in-charge of the Rotaprint Section at that time?
Reasons for not taking action at that time when these surplus items were moved from Rotaprint/Bindery Store before the verification by O&M Section.
From where these surplus items, which did not belong to Rotaprint/Bindery Store, came to be dumped/stored in Screen Printing Room of the Rotaprint Section?

Whether these surplus items listed by Shri Shovan Chaudhary then discharging duties of Store Keeper of Rotaprint/Bindery Store are still lying in the Screen Printing Room of Rotaprint Section or have been moved to any other room of Rotaprint Section (Pls. specify) and if not, the whereabouts of all these surplus items?

Whether these surplus items have been taken on the inventory/merged with other bulk items of the Rotaprint/Bindery Store. If yes, then who was the competent authority who ordered that the 13 surplus items listed by Shri Shovan Chaudhary be merged with other store items? Pls. provide the photocopy of such orders. If not, the reasons therefore?
Pls. provide the photocopy of the pages of the register in which items mentioned by Sh. Shovan Chowdhary, in his note, as surplus items, (each item-wise).
For G.P. Branch: Pls. provide the value of the items mentioned by Sh. Shovan Chowdhary, in his note, as surplus items, (each item-wise).
If any discrepancy found after verification by O&M Section in the Rotaprint/Bindery Store in 2012. O&M Section may pls. provide the photocopy of order to resolve the issue of all discrepancies.

The then Joint Secretary(M) (Shri Louis Martin) who was JS(E) in the years 2010-2011, had ordered that Daily Output Register of each printing machine installed in Rotaprint Section be maintained. (a) Whether these registers are still being maintained after that order? (b) What is the average Daily Output of each printing machine kept in Rotaprint Section? (c) If the practice of maintaining Daily Output Register has been discontinued, Pls. provide the photocopy of order of the competent Authority to stop maintaining the Daily Output Register of each printing machine installed in Rotaprint Section.
response_summary: The Secretariat clarified the applicable rule defining Divisional Officer, identified Shri Virender Kumar as the then officer-in-charge of the Rotaprint/Bindery Store and Section, and stated that after re-checking, all 13 items were found to belong to the store and were merged without need for separate register entry. Cost details, reconciliation report photocopies were enclosed, but no order was available regarding the Daily Output Register.

questions: Total money spent on Parliament Session during 01.01.2015 to 15.09.2016 including subsidy on food and also number of hours it was suppose work and it actually worked.
response_summary: The Secretariat explained that Parliament session expenditure is incurred across multiple agencies with no single exclusive head of account, provided the Lok Sabha budget-grant expenditure link and an unaudited annexure for April-August 2016, and directed the applicant to the Lok Sabha website for sitting-hours data, also citing Rule 12 on standard sitting hours (11:00 to 18:00 with a lunch break).

Lok Sabha Secretariat, Rajya Sabha Secretariat, Ministry of Urban Development (CPWD) and other Ministries/departments. Lok Sabha Secretariat, Rajya Sabha Secretariat, Ministry of Urban Development (CPWD) and other Ministries/departments. There is no specific and exclusive Head of Account for booking the expenditure incurred by various Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat etc. in connection with the conduct of Parliament. However, Head of account-wise expenditure (including subsidy on food) incurred [from Financial year 2009-10 to 2015-16] out of Budget Grant of Lok Sabha and booked by P&AO, Lok Sabha, is available on Lok Sabha homepage. Expenditure incurred (un-audited) from 1.4.2016 to 31.8.2016 is enclosed (Annexure-I); September 2016 expenditure is yet to be compiled. Information on expenditure by other Ministries/Departments/Rajya Sabha Secretariat is not available with the Branch concerned. Information on hours actually worked is available on loksabha.nic.in under 'Business'-'Resume of Work' and 'Bulletin-I'. Standard sitting hours of Lok Sabha are governed by Rule 12 of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha: sittings ordinarily commence at 11.00 hours and conclude at 18.00 hours with a lunch break ordinarily from 13.00 to 14.00 hours.

title: जलगांव जिले में एमपीलैड निधि आवंटन संबंधी आवेदन शुल्क अस्वीकृत
subject: आवेदक ने जलगांव जिले से लोक सभा सांसद को आवंटित एमपीलैड निधि और संबंधित ब्यौरे की जानकारी माँगी थी, किंतु अविधिमान्य आवेदन शुल्क के कारण आवेदन अंतरित नहीं किया जा सका।
questions: जलगांव जिले से लोक सभा संसद सदस्य को आवंटित एमपीलैड निधि और संबंधित ब्यौरे की जानकारी।
response_summary: आवेदन शुल्क आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी, लोक सभा को संबोधित न होने से अविधिमान्य पाया गया, अतः आवेदन अंतरित नहीं किया जा सका और पोस्टल ऑर्डर वापस कर दिया गया। साथ ही विषय-वस्तु सांख्यिकी एवं कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय से संबंधित होने की सूचना दी गई।

title: RTI seeking details of MPs absent without permission 2014-2016
subject: The applicant sought names and numbers of Members of Parliament absent without permission from May 2014 to August 2016, and the rules governing leave of absence for MPs.
questions: Provide the name and number of those members who remain absent without permission of the House from May, 2014 to August, 2016.
Provide the names of the members and their political parties who remained absent without permission of the House?

Under the rules of Lok Sabha, what is the procedure for taking leave by a member of Parliament and what action can be taken against the members who remain absent from the sittings of the House without permission.
response_summary: The Secretariat explained that an Attendance Register is maintained and member-wise attendance data for the 16th Lok Sabha is available on the Lok Sabha website, directed the applicant there for party-wise details, and cited Article 101(4) of the Constitution and Rule 242 governing leave of absence procedures for MPs.

Reference: Lok Sabha Secretariat Letter No. 1(1655)/IC/16 dated 04.10.2016
Sl. No. | Information Sought | Reply
1. Provide the name and number of those members who remain absent without permission of the House from May, 2014 to August, 2016. | An Attendance Register is maintained for members (except Hon'ble Speaker, Deputy Speaker and Ministers) to sign against their names in token of having attended the sitting of the House on a particular day. Details of signing/not signing the Attendance Register by members of Lok Sabha during all the sessions of 16th Lok Sabha are available on the website of the Lok Sabha i.e., www.loksabha.nic.in under the headings Members->Attendance of Members -> 16th Lok Sabha -> Member-wise Attendance -> All Members respectively. The applicant may, however, note that it is possible that a member attended the sitting of the House on a particular day but did not sign the Attendance Register for that day. The applicant is advised to go through the above website of Lok Sabha for obtaining the desired information.
2. Provide the names of the members and their political parties who remained absent without permission of the House? | For party/state related information of the members, the applicant may be advised to access the relevant information from the Lok Sabha website www.loksabha.nic.in under the link Members -> Sitting Members -> Party wise Members in the selected State respectively.
3. Under the rules of Lok Sabha, what is the procedure for taking leave by a member of Parliament and what action can be taken against the members who remain absent from the sittings of the House without permission. | Article 101(4) of the Constitution provides that 'if for a period of sixty days a member of either House of Parliament is without permission of the House absent from all meetings thereof, the House may declare his seat vacant.' Rules 242 of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha provides that a member desiring permission of the House to remain absent from the sittings thereof under clause (4) of article 101 of the Constitution shall make an application in writing to the Speaker specifying the period for which leave of absence is required, indicating also the date of commencement and of termination of such leave of absence and the grounds for it and provided that leave of absence applied for at any one time shall not exceed a period of sixty days.

Article 101(4) of the Constitution and Rule 242 of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha govern leave of absence for members.

response_full_text: An Attendance Register is maintained for members (except Hon'ble Speaker, Deputy Speaker and Ministers) to sign against their names in token of having attended the sitting of the House on a particular day. Details of signing/not signing the Attendance Register by members of Lok Sabha during all the sessions of 16th Lok Sabha are available on the website of the Lok Sabha under Members->Attendance of Members -> 16th Lok Sabha -> Member-wise Attendance -> All Members. The applicant may note that a member may have attended the sitting but not signed the Register for that day, and is advised to consult the website. For party/state related information, the applicant may access the Lok Sabha website under Members -> Sitting Members -> Party wise Members in the selected State. Article 101(4) of the Constitution provides that if for a period of sixty days a member of either House of Parliament is without permission of the House absent from all meetings thereof, the House may declare his seat vacant. Rule 242 of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha provides that a member desiring permission to remain absent shall make a written application to the Speaker specifying the period, dates of commencement and termination, and the grounds, provided such leave does not exceed sixty days at a time.

[Attached: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 2453, Ministry of Tribal Affairs, answered on 31.07.2017]
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF TRIBAL AFFAIRS
LOK SABHA
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO: 2453
ANSWERED ON: 31.07.2017
Fake Certificates
SHRI HARI BABU KAMBHAMPATI
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:-
(a) Whether incidence of people getting fake Scheduled Tribes (STs) certificates have been reported/come to the notice of the Government recently;
(b) if so, the number of such cases reported/registered during each of the last three years and the current year, State/UT-wise; and
(c) the corrective action taken/being taken by the Government in this regard?
ANSWER
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF TRIBAL AFFAIRS (SHRI JASWANTSINH BHABHOR)
(a) to (b): While the Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the nodal ministry for notification of a community as Scheduled Tribe under Article 342 of Constitution of India, the responsibility for issuance and verification of Scheduled Tribe certificates rests with the concerned State Government/UT Administration. Thus, complaints received about fake Scheduled Tribe certificates are referred to the concerned State Government / UT Administration for appropriate action. The information on such cases is not centrally maintained.
(c) As informed by the Department of Personnel and Training, the extant instructions provide that if it is found that a Government servant had furnished false information or produced a false certificate in order to secure appointment, he should not be retained in service. Thus when an appointing authority comes to know that an employee had submitted a false/fake caste certificate, it has to initiate action to remove or dismiss such an employee from service as per the provisions of relevant Service Rules. The Government has also requested all the States/Union Territories from time to time to streamline the process for verification of claims of candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs) and Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and to issue instructions to District Magistrates / District Collectors / Deputy Commissioners to ensure at their own level the veracity of caste certificates so that unscrupulous non-SC/ST/OBC persons are prevented from securing jobs meant for SCs/STs/OBCs by producing false certificates. Further, in order to discourage unscrupulous activities, State Governments / Union Territories have also been requested to consider issue of appropriate instructions for initiating disciplinary proceedings against the errant officers who default in timely verification of caste certificates or who issue false certificates.

title: United Bank Section 19 Banking Act Interpretation Query Declined
department: सूचना प्रकोष्ठ (Information Cell), Lok Sabha Secretariat
subject: RTI raising questions on whether United Bank of India was authorised to bypass Section 19 of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertaking) Act, 1970, and whether the Committee on Subordinate Legislation permitted Syndicate Bank to frame private regulations under the same section.
questions: Whether United Bank of India was authorised by Parliament to boycott the section 19 of Banking Companies Acquisition and transfer of undertaking Act 1970 incorporated by Parliament to ensure that President acts on the codified advice of Council of Ministers issued as AOB (Allocation of Business Rules) and TOB (Transaction of Business Rules) rules under article 77 of Constitution.

Whether Hon Committee on Subordinate Legislation had nodded a signal to Syndicate Bank to frame Regulation privately and prosecute citizens for violation of this private rule without sanction of Central Government vide Section 19 (g) of the Banking Companies Acquisition and Transfer of Undertaking Act, 1970 read with AOB Rules being advice of Central Government on procedure for prosecution of citizens.
response_summary: It was clarified that the query involves interpretation of the Constitution/Laws, which does not fall within the Branch's functions. It was stated that the Committee on Subordinate Legislation has not advised any Bank, officially or unofficially, to frame regulations in violation of Section 19(1) of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970, and the application was also transferred to the Ministry of Finance.

title: सांसदों के वेतन, भत्तों और एमपीलैड्स निधि वृद्धि पर सूचना
department: सूचना प्रकोष्ठ (Information Cell), लोक सभा सचिवालय
subject: प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय से अंतरित आरटीआई आवेदन में संसद सदस्यों के वेतन-भत्तों, पेंशन और एमपीलैड्स निधि में वृद्धि से संबंधित जानकारी मांगी गई।
questions: हाल ही में 250 संसद सदस्यों के एक शिष्टमंडल ने संसद सदस्यों के वेतन, भत्तों, पेंशन सुविधाओं और एमपीलैड्स निधि में 5 गुना वृद्धि करने के लिए एक मांग पत्र प्रस्तुत किया। इस पत्र पर 250 संसद सदस्यों ने हस्ताक्षर किए थे। कृपया उक्त सदस्यों के नाम, पते और उनकी पार्टियों के नाम उपलब्ध कराएं।

कृपया याचिका पर हस्ताक्षर करने वाले 250 सदस्यों और अन्य सदस्यों द्वारा पिछले 10 वर्षों के दौरान एमपीलैड्स निधि के उपयोग के संबंध में जानकारी प्रदान करें। क्या यह उपयोग केन्द्र सरकार के दिशा निर्देशों के अनुसार किया गया या अन्य किसी प्रयोजन के अंतर्गत भी व्यय किया गया?
कृपया एमपीलैड्स निधि के उद्देश्य और उक्त निधि को 5 करोड़ रुपये से बढ़ाकर 25 करोड़ रुपये करने के कारणों की जानकारी दें।

कृपया नाम और पार्टियों के नाम सहित उन संसद सदस्यों का ब्यौरा दें जो स्टिंग आपरेशन में किसी विधिक कार्य के लिए एमपीलैड्स निधि जारी करने हेतु कमीशन की मांग करने के दोषी पाए गए थे। इसके अतिरिक्त यह भी बताएं कि उनके विरुद्ध क्या कानूनी कार्यवाही की गई है।

पिछले कुछ वर्षों के दौरान यह देखा गया है कि दिशानिर्देशों का उल्लंघन किया गया और संसद सदस्यों ने निजी क्षेत्रों अथवा रेलवे प्लेटफार्मों पर बेंच लगवाने के लिए एमपीलैड निधियों को खर्च किया है। कृपया ऐसे संसद सदस्यों के विरुद्ध की गई कार्यवाही का ब्यौरा दें।

कृपया उस उद्देश्य की जानकारी दें जिसके लिए संसद सदस्यों को वेतन, भत्ते और पेंशन सुविधाएं आदि प्रदान की जाती हैं। कृपया उक्त निधि में वृद्धि किए जाने के संबंध में कर्मचारी वेतन आयोग की सिफारिशों के संबंध में जानकारी दें।
राजनीति एक सामाजिक कार्य और राष्ट्र के प्रति सेवा है। कृपया उन बाध्यताओं की जानकारी दें जिनके अंतर्गत उक्त सेवा के बदले, वेतन, भत्तों और सुविधाओं में वृद्धि की गई है।
कृपया गत 70 वर्षों के दौरान संसद सदस्यों, अस्पतालों में सुधार, बेरोजगारी, बाढ़, गरीबी, शिक्षकों की कमी आदि पर किए गए व्यय का ब्यौरा दें।
response_summary: एमपीलैड्स संबंधी शाखा को ऐसा कोई मांग पत्र प्राप्त नहीं होने की जानकारी दी गई। एमपीलैड्स योजना के उद्देश्य और निधि वृद्धि के कारण बताए गए, तथा 2006 में गठित समिति की स्टिंग ऑपरेशन जांच रिपोर्ट का उल्लेख किया गया। वेतन/भत्ते संबंधी सूचना अधिनियम के तहत विनियमित होने की जानकारी दी गई जबकि कुछ बिंदु सचिवालय से संबंधित न होने अथवा अस्पष्ट होने के कारण उत्तरित नहीं किए जा सके।

5. सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय, एमपीलैड योजना के संबंध में दिशानिर्देश तैयार करने और उसके कार्यान्वयन की निगरानी करने हेतु एक नोडल मंत्रालय है। यह जानकारी उस मंत्रालय के पास उपलब्ध है।

subject: The applicant sought detailed information on the 42nd, 84th and 87th Constitutional Amendment Acts, including their objects, standing committee reports, discussions, ratification, delimitation data, and court challenges.
questions: Provide the following information regarding 42nd Amendment Act, 1976; 84th Amendment Act, 2001 and 87th Amendment Act, 2003 respectively, enacted to the Constitution, and related details.
The 'Aims and Objects' for enacting 42nd, 84th and 87th Constitutional Amendments 1976, 2004 and 2003 along with the complete amendments it made to articles 81, 82 and 170 of the Constitution.
Any report of the Standing Committee of Parliament in this regard.
Discussions made and votes in favour and against of the Amendment.
Were the amendments enacted Under Article 368(2)(d) of the Constitution. If yes, give the list of one half of the States who have ratified it, along with the dates.
Date of assent given by the President of India.

The decadal growth rate of population from 1971 to 2001 of each state and the allocation of seats made to them in every subsequent delimitation made by the Delimitation Commission for MP and MLA seats.

The Delimitation and Allocation of Seats to each state for elections to Parliament (MPs) and Legislative Assemblies (MLAs), including the increase in number of seats for SCs & STs from 2000 to 2016, made by the 4th Delimitation Commission. Give the report of the Commission.

Whether any Parliamentary Committee is studying the amendment to Article 81(3), 82 and 170(2)(3) of the Constitution for increasing the number of MPs and MLAs due to their disproportionate and non-representative ratio of: 1 MP: 23.28 lakh and 1 MLA: 2.93 lakhs.
What are the type/kind/nature of 'territorial constituencies' as envisaged by Articles 81, 82, 170 and 171(4) respectively.
Whether 84th Amendment Act 2001; 87th 2003 and 42nd 1976 were challenged in any constitutional court? If yes, give the details of the case along with the order of Hon'ble Court.
response_summary: The Secretariat answered questions on Standing Committee referrals, Lok Sabha passage dates and Presidential assent dates, and State ratification status for the three amendments, while transferring questions on aims/objects, population/delimitation data and court challenges to the Ministry of Law, Ministry of Home Affairs, Election Commission and Rajya Sabha Secretariat as relevant.

response_full_text: The 42nd Amendment Bill (1976) and 87th Amendment Bill (2003) were not referred to the Standing Committee; the 84th Amendment Bill (2001) was referred to the Standing Committee on Home Affairs, report laid on 26.4.2001. The Bills were passed by Lok Sabha on 2.11.1976, 21.8.2001 and 6.5.2003 respectively, and assented to by the President on 18.12.1976, 27.2.2002 and 22.6.2003 respectively. Point Nos. | Reply
1. In this context it is stated that the procedure to watch the proceedings of the Lok Sabha for a common man is that he has to fill an application form available at the CPIC/Reception office (Lok Sabha)/official website of Lok Sabha (www.parliamentofindia.nic.in), providing the details (Applicant's and his father's name in full, age, occupation, full local address and permanent address) required in the proforma and duly signed by an Hon'ble MP (Lok Sabha) from his constituency or any other constituency. The passes for the galleries may be issued one-day advance only. Children below the age of 10 years are not permitted. The proceedings can be watched during the session period (i.e. when the House is in session) subject to the availability of the seats in the public gallery.
2. During the session time limit for which pass visitor's gallery pass issued is an hour. The visitor below 10 years is not allowed in the visitor's gallery. The seating capacity of visitor's gallery is of 230 seats.
3. The total number of passes issued for the Public Gallery during the year 2014 in the three Lok Sabha sessions so far is 4495 visitors in the 15th session of 15th Lok Sabha (05 Feb to 21 Feb. 2014), 3678 visitors in 1st session of 16th Lok Sabha (04 June to 11 June 2014) and 17905 visitors in 2nd session of 16th Lok Sabha (07 July to 14 August 2014). The above mentioned numbers include all categories of visitors i.e. male, female, students and guests of MPs and staff members of Lok Sabha Sectt. within the permissible age limit provided in point number 1. There is no segregation of visitors available on the above mentioned basis.
4. In this connection it is stated that a request may be sent through the head of the institution addressed to the Secretary General of Lok Sabha or the Hon'ble Speaker of the Lok Sabha during the session of Lok Sabha giving full details including Name in full (non abbreviated) of the individuals, father's name (non abbreviated), age, nationality, occupation, Local Delhi Address and Permanent address may be provided to the Secretariat well in advance. The passes will be valid for one hour and the children below the age of 10 years will not be allowed during the session period as per the guidelines. The pass has to be collected in person by an authorized person before 1800 hrs on the preceding day to watch the proceedings. The date may be confirmed on phone by your institution.
5. It is stated that there is no proviso of lodging by the CPIC for the visitors coming to see the proceedings of Lok Sabha. There is no information available regarding the provisions for the visitors in the State guest houses.
response_full_text: In this context it is stated that the procedure to watch the proceedings of the Lok Sabha for a common man is that he has to fill an application form available at the CPIC/Reception office (Lok Sabha)/official website of Lok Sabha, providing the details required in the proforma and duly signed by an Hon'ble MP (Lok Sabha). The passes for the galleries may be issued one-day advance only. Children below the age of 10 years are not permitted. During the session, the time limit for which visitor's gallery pass is issued is an hour; seating capacity is 230 seats. The total number of passes issued for the Public Gallery during 2014 across the three Lok Sabha sessions so far is 4495, 3678 and 17905 visitors respectively. A request for institutional group visits may be sent to the Secretary General or Hon'ble Speaker with full details of visitors. There is no provision of lodging by the CPIC for visitors, and no information is available regarding provisions for visitors in State guest houses.

questions: The applicant has got audio proof of involvement of Shri A. K. Singh, AS, Lok Sabha Secretariat in corrupt practices and financial transactions. There is proof of bribe being given by victim and demand made for money. Kindly inform as to who this evidence should be sent to in order to ensure fair and proper action against him.

A number of employees and Officers of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha have been misusing Government money by producing rent receipt besides claiming HRA. Kindly provide complete details of the personnel drawing such benefits including the address of rented accommodation, name of house owner and his/her relationship with the employee/officer. Please also provide details of money claimed till August, 2015.
response_summary: The Secretariat held that the corruption allegation did not qualify as 'information' under Section 2(f) of the RTI Act, and that the HRA-related query was too vague to answer; the application was also transferred to Rajya Sabha Secretariat.
